headlines.title: Catastrophic Floods in Nepal Leave Hundreds Missing
headlines.description: Terrifying images from the China-Nepal border show a monster wave crashing down from the mountains, sweeping away everything in its path, including vehicles, buildings, and even people. The desperate search for survivors is underway with hundreds still missing, including dozens of American tourists. NBC’s Janis Mackey Frayer reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Families wait in agony as Nepal floods leaves hundreds missing
headlines.description: A New York couple traveling to Mount Kailash is among 65 Americans missing after a catastrophic flood along the Nepal-Tibet border.

headlines.title: Trump signs executive order to rename Lake Ontario to 'Lake America'
headlines.description: President Trump signed an executive order that calls for the renaming of Lake Ontario to "Lake America."

headlines.title: How jurors and Lindsay Clancy reacted during closing arguments
headlines.description: NBC News' Emilie Ikeda describes the emotion of the courtroom during closing arguments at the Lindsay Clancy murder trial. NBC News' Danny Cevallos breaks down the charges the jury is considering as deliberations begin.

headlines.title: Dolly: An NBC News Special
headlines.description: An in-depth look at the life and legacy of superstar Dolly Parton.

headlines.title: Tim Curry, star of ‘Rocky Horror Picture Show’ and ‘It,’ dies at 80
headlines.description: The English actor became a fan favorite for his portrayal of Dr. Frank-N-Furter in 1975’s “The Rocky Horror Picture Show,” but he also had a host of other iconic screen performances to his name.

headlines.title: A near-total lunar eclipse will be visible across the U.S. tonight
headlines.description: Two weeks after a total solar eclipse wowed skywatchers in Europe, a near-total lunar eclipse is in store Thursday for people in North and South America.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Callaway severs ties with golf brand after controversial ad sparks outrage
headlines.description: Fallout from a golf commercial described as “the worst ad known to man” continued Thursday when Callaway, one of the sport’s largest makers of equipment, announced it had cut ties with Good Good Golf, the brand it had partnered with for the past three years before their joint ad sparked controversy.

headlines.title: Tristan Tate testifying for his bail as he and brother fight extradition to U.K.
headlines.description: Attorneys for Andrew and Tristan Tate, the “manosphere” influencers accused of sex crimes in the United Kingdom, fought for their freedom on Thursday, telling a federal judge that the defendants are not a flight risk.

headlines.title: Trump signs executive order to rename Lake Ontario to ‘Lake America’
headlines.description: President Donald Trump on Thursday signed an executive order to rename Lake Ontario “Lake America.”

headlines.title: Wyoming’s Republican governor raises concerns over ‘aggressive’ DOJ election monitors
headlines.description: Wyoming Republican Gov. Mark Gordon raises concerns Wednesday over election observers
